title: 24 Years for Enron's CEO. Then It Became 14.

lines.say: Twenty-four years and four months. Enron's former CEO, Jeffrey Skilling, sentenced in two thousand six.
lines.show: 24 years and 4 months. Enron's former CEO, Jeffrey Skilling, sentenced in 2006.

lines.say: An appeals court threw out the sentence. Then the Supreme Court limited honest-services fraud, one theory against him, to bribes and kickbacks.

scene.q: We therefore hold that §1346 covers only bribery and kickback schemes.

lines.say: His convictions stood. In two thousand thirteen, a new sentence: fourteen years. He was released in two thousand nineteen.
lines.show: His convictions stood. In 2013, a new sentence: 14 years. He was released in 2019.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.

label: SWORN
